)

targets.expression:
WITH RankedShorts AS (
  SELECT
    "PRODUCT_CODE",
    "PRODUCT",
    "PERCENT_OF_TOTAL_PRODUCT_IN_ISSUE_REPORTED_AS_SHORT_POSITIONS",
    "DATE",
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "PRODUCT_CODE" ORDER BY "PERCENT_OF_TOTAL_PRODUCT_IN_ISSUE_REPORTED_AS_SHORT_POSITIONS" DESC) as rank
  FROM
    shorts
  WHERE
    "DATE" > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month'
)
SELECT
  "PRODUCT_CODE" || ' - ' || "PRODUCT" as metric,
  "PERCENT_OF_TOTAL_PRODUCT_IN_ISSUE_REPORTED_AS_SHORT_POSITIONS" AS "shorted percentage"
FROM
  RankedShorts
WHERE
  rank = 1
ORDER BY
  "shorted percentage" DESC
LIMIT
  10;

SELECT
  "DATE" AS "time",
  "PRODUCT_CODE" AS "metric",
  "PERCENT_OF_TOTAL_PRODUCT_IN_ISSUE_REPORTED_AS_SHORT_POSITIONS" AS "value"
FROM
  shorts
WHERE
  "PRODUCT_CODE" IN ($top10shorts)
  AND "DATE" > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 month'
ORDER BY
  "DATE" ASC;

notes: stocks variable is unused; top10shorts drives the line chart.

Top-ten RANK query may return duplicate stock codes on tied maxima.
